svg.text: Perfboard build plan (5 x 7 cm protoboard, 24 x 18 holes)
Columns A to X from the right wall, rows 18 (back) to 1 (front), as printed on the board (A18 is its back right corner, seen from above).
Component side, seen from above (the room at the bottom)
USB end toward the left wall
Solder side: the board turned over left to right (A now on the left). Numbered wires as in the table.
Values: R1-R5 10k, R6 1k, R7 100k, R8 22k, R9 R10 4.7k (1/4 W); C1 100 uF 25 V. R1-R4, R9, R10 stand up; R5-R8 lie flat in row
7, so they pass under the edges of the ESP32 and the TMC2209 (2.6 mm up on their pin spacers).
Headers: 1 x 4 and 1 x 3 male, 2.54 mm. The fan plugs (J2, J3) go on with their latch toward row 2; keep row 2 clear there.
AS5600: tie its DIR pin to GND at the module. TMC2209: CLK and PDN stay free (wires 38-39 go to its UART pin; check with a meter
that UART is PDN_UART on your module); DIAG (GPIO 13) is not on its pins, so it stays free too.
Solder the parts first, then the ESP32 and the TMC2209: the wires under them must be in place before. Check each net with a
meter before power; 12 V on J1 only with the motor plugged in.
Thin insulated wire (wire-wrap or 26-30 AWG), except 22-24 AWG
for the 12 V and GND around the driver (1-14) and the motor (58-61).
